def make_feats(idx, promo=None, include_promo=False, start=df.index[0]):
    d = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    if include_promo:

    return d

from math import sqrt
def forecast_models(train, fdate):
    train = train.copy()
    train['month']=train.index.month
    train['t']=((train.index.year-df.index[0].year)*12 + (train.index.month-df.index[0].month)).astype(int)
    # promo fill
    train['promo_filled']=train['promo_intensity'].fillna(train['promo_intensity'].mean())
    # forecast promo: avg same month if available else mean, maybe ridge if enough
    same=train[train.index.month==fdate.month]['promo_intensity'].dropna()
    p_future = float(same.mean() if len(same)>0 else train['promo_intensity'].mean())
    out={}
    # seasonal naive same month last year
    try:
        out['seasonal_naive']=float(train.loc[fdate-pd.DateOffset(years=1),'sales_units'])
    except KeyError:
        out['seasonal_naive']=np.nan
    # yoy avg growth seasonal naive
    try:
        # same month last year times average growth for last 12 months over previous
        gr=[]
        for dt in train.index[-12:]:
            prev=dt-pd.DateOffset(years=1)
            if prev in train.index:
                gr.append(train.loc[dt,'sales_units']/train.loc[prev,'sales_units'])
        g=np.nanmedian(gr) if len(gr)>0 else 1
        out['seasonal_yoy']=out['seasonal_naive']*g if np.isfinite(out['seasonal_naive']) else np.nan
    except Exception:
        out['seasonal_yoy']=np.nan
    # ridge Fourier no promo & promo
    try:
        X=make_feats(train.index, include_promo=False, start=df.index[0])
        Xf=make_feats(pd.DatetimeIndex([fdate]), include_promo=False, start=df.index[0])
        mdl=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), RidgeCV(alphas=np.logspace(-3,4,50))).fit(X, np.log(train.sales_units))
        out['ridge_nopromo']=float(np.exp(mdl.predict(Xf)[0]))
    except Exception as e:
        out['ridge_nopromo']=np.nan
    try:
        X=make_feats(train.index, promo=train['promo_filled'].values, include_promo=True, start=df.index[0])
        Xf=make_feats(pd.DatetimeIndex([fdate]), promo=np.array([p_future]), include_promo=True, start=df.index[0])
        mdl=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), RidgeCV(alphas=np.logspace(-3,4,50))).fit(X, np.log(train.sales_units))
        out['ridge_promo']=float(np.exp(mdl.predict(Xf)[0]))
    except Exception as e:
        out['ridge_promo']=np.nan
    # ETS if >= 24
    if len(train)>=24:
        for seas in ['add','mul']:
            try:
                mdl=ExponentialSmoothing(train.sales_units, trend='add', seasonal=seas, seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method='estimated').fit(optimized=True)
                out[f'ets_{seas}']=float(mdl.forecast(1).iloc[0])
            except Exception:
                out[f'ets_{seas}']=np.nan
    return out

rows=[]
